Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: question(s) Creation 1.1 Self- By the end of the Sub strand, the ● Learners to r
Topic 1.2: My Creation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on My Creation. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how to relate with members of you not share at unity the extended family home?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify members of the extended family ●Learners to draw and colour members of their 2.
2. state items that should not be shared at ●

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: MY CREATION
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
My Creation helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: MY CREATION
Study My Creation like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify members of the extended family ●Learners to draw and colour members of their 2.

What this means
In this part you learn to identify members of the extended family ●Learners to draw and colour members of their 2.. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify members of the extended family ●Learners to draw and colour members of their 2..
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “My Creation” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify members of the extended family ●Learners to draw and colour members of their 2.. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: State items that should not be shared at ●

What this means
In this part you learn to state items that should not be shared at ●. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: state items that should not be shared at ●.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to My Creation in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can state items that should not be shared at ●. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what My Creation is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “My Creation” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify members of the extended family ●Learners to draw and colour members of their 2.)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to My Creation in your own words. (skill: state items that should not be shared at ●)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach My Creation to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify members of the extended family ●Learners to draw and colour members of their 2..
3. Practise this skill: state items that should not be shared at ●.
4. Make one local Kenya example of My Creation from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for My Creation: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study My Creation?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how to relate with members of you not share at unity the extended family home?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what My Creation means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify members of the extended family ●Learners to draw and colour members of their 2..
5. Be able to: state items that should not be shared at ●.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
